messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: error handling templating
parts:
On Friday, February 1, 2013 12:07:44 PM UTC-5, Bob Carpenter wrote:
I'm assuming this is because there's not a VectorView
for Eigen matrices.  Should there be, or should I generate
different code that explicitly tests a row at a time in
the model?

I think there should be a VectorView for Eigen matrices, just because we want

M ~ normal(0,1);

to work soon where M is a matrix. But whether you want to use a VectorView for the error handling is another issue. You could just do something like

(M.array() >= bound) .all();

Ben

messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] Re: error handling templating
parts: On Fri, Feb 1, 2013 at 12:44 PM, Ben Goodrich <goodri...@gmail.com> wrote:

I think there should be a VectorView for Eigen matrices, just because we want

M ~ normal(0,1);

to work soon where M is a matrix.

Is that true? At some point, we need to build a MatrixView for Eigen matrices, but I'm not sure VectorView should allow for general Eigen matrices. I know for this case, it makes sense. I just don't know if we can build the metaprograms generally enough to cover all conditions. Of course, I could be overthinking it.
